subtitle: Integrated Arthroscopy Pump
jcr:title: CrossFlow
jcr:description: Stryker's CrossFlow Integrated Arthroscopy pump is an excellent solution when seeking simplicity and versatility, without compromising performance. ReconiSense Technology allows the pump to determine optimal suction rates for our cutters, burs, and RF probes to provide consistent visualization and decreased fluid usage by managing suction. With CrossFlow, you will experience true integration.

text_copy.text:
True integration

Fluid management integrated with resection

text_copy_copy.text:
Customization

Custom surgeon profiles for unique fluid and resection settings

Temperature control

ReconiSense TC includes temperature monitoring and mitigation features

largeheadline_1996882545.line1: Integration that users will appreciate
largeheadline_1996882545.line2: Stryker's CrossFlow pump is an integrated inflow and outflow system designed to improve performance1 and increase efficiency2. An easy-to-use interface paired with Stryker’s ReconiSense technology allows integration from fluid management to resection performance.

text.text:
A. Easy to use interface allows for simplicity to begin each case.

B. Pre-set pressure, flow and suction settings specific to each joint space

C. Custom surgeon profiles allow for unique setting adjustments designed to meet each users needs

D. Cassette-style tubing eliminates need to wrap tubing prior to cases

E. Option to use inflow-only, or inflow and outflow mode 

F. Accessories including autoclavable hand control and CrossFlow footswitch

G. Multiple tubing options, including Day-Use/Patient-Use and integrated

largeheadline_199688.line1: True integration
largeheadline_199688.line2: Between CrossFlow integrated arthroscopy pump and CrossFire 2 resection console

text_copy.text: Connection via Firewire cable to the CrossFire 2 allows the CrossFlow pump to maintain set pressure and determine specific suction rates for Stryker's cutters, burs and RF probes

text_copy_copy_936015986.text: Designed to provide consistent visualization by managing suction while debriding bone and soft tissue

text_copy_copy_1534317947.text: One footswitch controls CrossFlow pump functionality, Formula shaver handpieces and SERFAS energy probes

largeheadline_199688_1433338822.line1: Custom surgeon profiles
largeheadline_199688_1433338822.line2: For unique and customizable fluid management and resection settings

text_copy_copy_copy.text: Stryker's console customizer app allows preferred settings for fluid management and resection to be saved, eliminating the need to adjust during each case

text_copy_copy_93601.text: The CrossFire footswitch has customizable buttons that allow control over Formula handpieces, SERFAS energy probes and the CrossFlow pump

text_copy_copy_15343.text: Pre-programmed user profiles are uploaded onto the CrossFlow pump and CrossFire 2 consoles to allow custom settings to auto populate before users enter the OR

largeheadline_199688_1254375013.line1: Temperature control
largeheadline_199688_1254375013.line2: With ReconiSense TC temperature monitoring and mitigation features

text_copy.text: ReconiSense TC utilizes the integration between the CrossFlow arthroscopy pump and the CrossFire 2 resection console to determine the temperature state of the joint space 95% accurate within +/-4.63°C.3

text_copy_copy_936015986.text: When the CrossFlow recognizes the temperature state of the joint is increasing, it will increase suction and flow rates to turn over fluid in the joint faster.4

text_copy_copy_1534317947.text: Sensorless temperature readings give you real time temperature displays on the pump screen

pageshortdescription.shortDescTop:
Stryker’s CrossFlow Integrated Arthroscopy Pump combines high end performance and resection integration to create one of the most cutting edge fluid management systems on the market. 

Best in Class Performance

1.bullet: ReconiSense Technology: While other pumps provide minimal coordination with resection devices, CrossFlow provides true integration with our shavers and RF by optimizing the suction rates for each disposable.

2.bullet: On-Demand Assistance: A built-in intelligence system provides you with "how-to" instructions for each console feature and function.

3.bullet: LowFlow software is designed to optimize performance with more immediate response times to pressure and flow changes in the joint.

4.bullet: ReconiSense Technology provides a “pressure boost” when a resection device is activated to provide optimal distention during resection.
